rules: Organizer and federation calendars preferred; World Athletics used for national championship/event calendar corroboration.
Do not copy 2026 routes, GPX or elevation to 2027 without explicit edition validation.
Elevation difference is not cumulative ascent.
Separate event date confirmation from route/distance confirmation.
Keep audit separate from live event records; no old GPX deletion or overwrite.
